## 分析目的

比較 113 年**產業移工**（事業面）與**家庭看護工**（家庭面）的實際時薪，
檢驗在名目月薪差距之外，當計入實際工時後，看護工的時薪是否顯著偏低。

---

## 資料說明

| 資料集 | 問卷類型 | 權重 | 薪資欄位 | 工時欄位 |
|--------|---------|------|---------|---------|
| `data113.csv`（事業面） | 產業移工（製造業／營造業） | `w2` | `q7ca`+`q7cb` | `q7b`+`q7bb` |
| `data113.csv`（家庭面） | 家庭看護工 | `w` | `nq10a`+`nq10ab` | 依作息時間計算 |

**家庭面工時計算**：每日工時 = 下班時間（`nq9a_2`+12）− 上班時間（`nq9a_1`）− 休息時數（`nq9b_1` + `nq9b_2`/60），
每月工作天數 = 30 − 每月放假天數（依 `q13a` 對應）。

> `q13a` 放假頻率對應：1=每月4–5次（≈4.5天）；2=每月1次（1天）；3=每月2–3次（≈2.5天）；5=都不放假（0天）。

---

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(showtext)
library(Hmisc)
library(patchwork)

font_add_google("Noto Sans TC", "NotoSans")
showtext_auto()
```

```{r load-data}
base_dir <- if (basename(getwd()) == "reports") ".." else "."
data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "data")

# ── 事業面（產業移工）──────────────────────────────────────
d_biz <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "113年移工/事業面/data113.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    group      = "產業移工\n（製造業／營造業）",
    w          = as.numeric(w2),
    salary     = as.numeric(q7ca) + suppressWarnings(as.numeric(q7cb)),
    hours      = as.numeric(q7b)  + suppressWarnings(as.numeric(q7bb))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(salary), !is.na(hours), salary > 0, hours > 0, w > 0) %>%
  mutate(hourly = salary / hours)

# ── 家庭面（看護工）──────────────────────────────────────
leave_days <- c("1" = 4.5, "2" = 1.0, "3" = 2.5, "4" = NA_real_, "5" = 0.0)

d_home <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "113年移工/家庭面/data113.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    group    = "家庭看護工",
    w        = as.numeric(w),
    salary   = as.numeric(nq10a) + suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nq10ab)),
    start_h  = as.numeric(nq9a_1),
    end_h    = as.numeric(nq9a_2) + 12,   # PM → 24h
    break_h  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nq9b_1)) +
               suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nq9b_2)) / 60,
    leave_code = as.character(q13a)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    leave    = leave_days[leave_code],
    daily_h  = end_h - start_h - replace_na(break_h, 0),
    monthly_h = daily_h * (30 - replace_na(leave, NA_real_)),
    hourly   = salary / monthly_h
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hourly), !is.na(w), hourly > 0, hourly < 500,
         salary > 0, monthly_h > 0, w > 0)

d_all <- bind_rows(d_biz, d_home) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("家庭看護工",
                                          "產業移工\n（製造業／營造業）")))
```

```{r summary}
hourly_summary <- d_all %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    wtd_median = wtd.quantile(hourly, weights = w, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtd_mean   = weighted.mean(hourly, w, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )
```

```{r compute-missing-rate}
# ── 失聯率：來自問卷自答（107–113年間曾發生失聯）──────────
# 事業面 q4==2 → 曾有移工失聯；家庭面 q5==2 → 曾有移工失聯

biz_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "113年移工/事業面/data113.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(w = as.numeric(w2), had_missing = as.integer(q4 == 2))

home_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "113年移工/家庭面/data113.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(w = as.numeric(w), had_missing = as.integer(q5 == 2))

missing_rate <- bind_rows(
  biz_raw  %>% mutate(group = "產業移工\n（製造業／營造業）"),
  home_raw %>% mutate(group = "家庭看護工")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(w), w > 0, !is.na(had_missing)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(miss_rate = weighted.mean(had_missing, w, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("家庭看護工",
                                          "產業移工\n（製造業／營造業）")))

# ── 合併至 hourly_summary ──────────────────────────────────
d_plot <- left_join(hourly_summary, missing_rate, by = "group")
```

---

## 核心圖表：時薪 × 失聯率（同一張圖）

```{r combined-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.5}
col_caregiver <- "#DE4429"
col_industry  <- "#1F3145"
group_colors  <- c("家庭看護工"                    = col_caregiver,
                   "產業移工\n（製造業／營造業）"   = col_industry)

# X 軸上限留出空間給失聯率標注
x_max <- max(d_plot$wtd_median) * 1.7

p_hourly <- ggplot(d_plot,
                   aes(x = wtd_median, y = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # ① 時薪數值（緊貼長條右端）
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(wtd_median, 0), " 元／時"),
        color = group),
    hjust = -0.12, size = 6, fontface = "bold", family = "NotoSans",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # ② 失聯率標注（固定在 x_max * 0.78 處，框線突顯）
  geom_label(
    aes(x     = x_max * 0.78,
        label = paste0("失聯率\n", percent(miss_rate, 0.1)),
        color = group),
    fill        = "white",
    label.size  = 0.5,
    size        = 5.5,
    fontface    = "bold",
    family      = "NotoSans",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, " 元"),
    limits = c(0, x_max),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "家庭看護工時薪低、失聯率卻高",
    subtitle = "加權時薪中位數（左，新台幣）；失聯率（右，雇主自答曾於107–113年間發生失聯）",
    x        = "時薪（元／時）",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "資料來源：勞動部移工管理及運用調查，113 年；事業面 q4、家庭面 q5；以抽樣權重計算"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "NotoSans", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 13, color = "#555555",
                                      margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa", size = 11),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(angle = 0, size = 14),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

p_hourly
```

## 輔助：時薪分布（箱形圖）

```{r boxplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
p_box <- ggplot(d_all, aes(x = hourly, y = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE,
               coef = 1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, quantile(d_all$hourly, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    title    = "時薪分布比較（98th 百分位截斷）",
    subtitle = "個體資料分布；未加權",
    x        = "時薪（元／時）",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "資料來源：同上"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "NotoSans", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 13, color = "#555555",
                                      margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa", size = 11),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(angle = 0, size = 14),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

p_box
```

## 數字摘要

```{r summary-table}
hourly_summary %>%
  mutate(
    wtd_median = round(wtd_median, 1),
    wtd_mean   = round(wtd_mean, 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    職業類別         = group,
    樣本數           = n,
    時薪加權中位數   = wtd_median,
    時薪加權平均數   = wtd_mean
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "各職業別時薪統計摘要（元／時）")
```

dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

## 結論

```{r conclusion, results="asis"}
med_care <- hourly_summary %>% filter(str_detect(group, "看護")) %>% pull(wtd_median)
med_ind  <- hourly_summary %>% filter(str_detect(group, "產業")) %>% pull(wtd_median)

cat(glue::glue(
  "- **家庭看護工**加權時薪中位數為 **{round(med_care, 0)} 元／時**，",
  "**產業移工**為 **{round(med_ind, 0)} 元／時**；",
  "看護工時薪僅為產業移工的 **{round(med_care/med_ind*100, 0)}%**。\n",
  "- 家庭看護工名目月薪雖接近產業移工，但在實際工時顯著偏長（無強制休假、24 小時待命）下，",
  "換算時薪後差距明顯拉大，凸顯現行勞動條件的結構性不平等。\n"
))
```
